tour.title: Choose your workspace
tour.description: Choose a function first, then select Artanrecords, Neuroartan or Artan Store. Only workspaces assigned to you are available.

tour.title: Understand your organization
tour.description: Organization shows reporting lines and the departments and offices in the selected brand. A defined office is not a staff appointment.

tour.title: Manage access carefully
tour.description: Authorized managers can assign verified accounts within their reporting branch. Reporting titles never replace explicit permissions, and the CEO account is protected.

tour.title: Manage your own account
tour.description: Open the account image at the bottom left for personal details, appearance settings, password recovery and Help.

search.title: Search your workspace
search.placeholder: Find a tool, person or decision
search.description: Search accessible tools, functions, design sources and tagged documents in this workspace. Reviews, documents, vacancies and decisions include up to 100 recent records per source.
